name: china-entry-rules
title: China and Hong Kong Entry Rules for International Bachelor Applicants (2026)
description: China and Hong Kong Entry Rules for International Bachelor Applicants (2026): Which school certificates are accepted, admission calendars, language and preparatory routes, the HSK 3.0 transition, apostille, study visas by passport and work rules for students. Scope: 16 mainland universities in the ARWU 2026 top 100 plus 3 in Hong Kong. The Long Bet, original research by M. Atamanova. Version 2026.11, data checked up to 2026-11-08.

fields.name: university_id
fields.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets (e.g. `tsinghua-university`).

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: School-leaving certificate: `ru_attestat_ege` (Russian attestat with EGE), `tr_lise_diplomasi` (Turkish lise diploma), `rs_matura` (Serbian matura), `eu_school_leaving` (EU school-leaving certificates such as Abitur, baccalaureat, maturita), `uk_a_level`.

fields.name: accepted
fields.description: `yes` = the certificate is named as accepted; `yes_generic_hs_diploma` = any high school diploma accepted, certificate not named; `conditional` = accepted with an extra step; `not_stated`.

fields.name: certificate_named
fields.description: Name of the certificate as written on the page, when named.

fields.name: extra_requirements
fields.description: Tests, language and other requirements on top of the certificate.

fields.name: document_rules
fields.description: Rules on transcripts, translations, notarisation and apostille.

fields.name: min_grades
fields.description: Minimum grades for this certificate, when published.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: Intake the page refers to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: `found` = the fact was read on the source page; `not_found` = the page was checked and the fact is not there: the row records what was looked for, `source_url` gives the URL tried and `note` says what was missing.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Page(s) where the fact is stated, "; "-separated, primary pages first. For `not_found` rows: the page(s) tried.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: `official` = university, government, embassy, airport or ranking publisher page; `law` = legal act; `secondary` = media, Wikipedia, agencies, aggregators.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date the row was last read on the source, ISO 8601.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: `verified` = read on an official or legal page for the current cycle; `partial` = official but older cycle or incomplete, or a reputable secondary source; `estimate` = derived or calculated, method in `note`. Empty for `not_found` rows.
